db45162fdca7f8ed.title: Many patient, consumer reps on FDA advisory panels have ties to groups funded by pharma, analysis finds
digest: Nearly 40% of Food and Drug Administration advisory committee meetings held over a recent 20-year period included either a patient or consumer representative with active ties to an advocacy group funded by pharmaceutical companies, according to a new analysis.
And for several committees, the number of such reps exceeded 50%.
Yet most of these organizational ties were not disclosed at the meetings, raising questions about voting behavior.

55115e41bd774378.title: An enzyme-responsive nanoplatform rewires host-microbe tryptophan metabolism for cancer immunotherapy.
digest: Immunotherapy shows great promise against cancer, yet imbalanced tryptophan (Trp) metabolism drives tumor immune tolerance, severely limiting its efficacy.
To produce an oral co-delivery nanoparticle, mesoporous silica nanoparticles are loaded with Trp via ester bonds and coated with agar containing the metabolism inhibitor NLG919 (NLG).
This design enables enzyme-responsive release of Trp and NLG in the large intestine, where microbiota and colorectal tumors coexist.
